layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: Abstract

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: Learning-based real image dehazing methods have

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: achieved notable progress， yet they still face adaptation

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: challenges in diverse real haze scenes. These challenges

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: mainly stem from the lack of effective unsupervised mech-

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: anisms for unlabeled data and the heavy cost of full model

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: fine-tuning. To address these challenges,we propose the

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: haze-to-clear text-directed loss that leverages CLIP's cross-

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: modal capabilities to reformulate real image dehazing as a

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: semantic alignment problem in latent space,thereby pro-

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: viding explicit unsupervised cross-modal guidance in the

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: absence of reference images. Furthermore,we introduce

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: the Bilevel Layer-positioning LoRA (BiLaLoRA） strategy,

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: which learns both the LoRA parameters and automatically

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: search the injection layers,enabling targeted adaptation of

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: critical network layers.Extensive experiments demonstrate

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: our superiority against state-of-the-art methods on multiple

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: real-world dehazing benchmarks. The code is publicly

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: available at https://github.com/YanZhang-zy/BiLaLoRA.

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: 1. Introduction

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: Image dehazing,as one of the core research directions in

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: low-level vision tasks,aims to remove atmospheric degra-

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: dation caused by scattering and particulate absorption,en-

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: hancing visual quality and facilitating downstream tasks.

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: Traditional dehazing algorithms primarily rely on hand-

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: crafted priors,yet idealized assumptions limit their appli-

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: cability [19]. In recent years,deep learning-based meth-

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: ods have demonstrated remarkable performance on syn-

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: thetic datasets [14] [21] [22] [31]. These methods typically

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: synthesize haze images based on the atmospheric scatter-

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: ing model,but the modeling process often oversimplifies

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: the complex light field distribution and medium character-

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: istics in the atmosphere, leading to significant domain gap

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: between synthetic data and real-world scenarios [25] [29].

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: To mitigate this issue,researchers have begun exploring

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: domain adaptation strategies to improve generalization ca-

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: pability [15] [36]. Despite notable progress,existing ap-

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: proaches still face two critical challenges:

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: · Lack of effective unsupervised mechanisms: Clean

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: ground truth is hard to acquire in real scenes, so mod-

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: els often rely on synthetic data or weak priors,making

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: it crucial to design effective unsupervised objectives for

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: unpaired haze images to achieve robust dehazing across

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: diverse real-world conditions.

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: · The heavy cost of full model fine-tuning: Even with ef-

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: fective unsupervised objectives,real image dehazing of-

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: ten depends on updating all network parameters, leading

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: to high computational and memory costs.This hinders

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: fast adaptation in practical deployments,making it nec-

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: essary to develop more effcient adaptation strategies.

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: 2. Related Works

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: To address the domain adaptation challenges faced by

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: dehazing models trained on synthetic data when ap-

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: plied to real-world scenes,we propose the Bilevel Layer-

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: positioning LoRA (BiLaLoRA) framework. As shown in

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: Fig.1,BiLaLoRA outperforms existing methods across

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: three real-world datasets. Specifically,we first utilize the

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: CLIP model [34] to design a Haze-to-Clear text-directed

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: loss (H2C), reframing the dehazing task as a semantic map-

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: ping from haze to clear images.As shown in Fig.2, the H2C

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: loss significantly enhances the performance of pre-trained

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: models across various real-world scenes.However, Table 1

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: shows that applying the H2C loss with full fine-tuning in-

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: curs high computational costs with limited adaptability.

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: · To address the lack of effective unsupervised mecha-

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: nisms，we propose the H2C loss by leveraging CLIP's

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: cross-modal capability. It reformulates the dehazing pro-

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: cess as a semantic alignment task in latent space, enabling

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: flexible optimization without requiring paired real data.

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: · With minimal computational and storage overhead, Bi-

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: LaLoRA achieves effcient transfer from synthetic to real

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: domains. Its plug-and-play nature supports rapid switch-

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: ing multiple target domains, achieving an optimal balance

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: among performance, efficiency,and flexibility.

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: 2.2.Parameter-Efficient Fine-Tuning

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: 1.1. Our Main Contributions

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: Through comprehensive analysis of the domain adapta-

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: tion process,we observe that the performance bottleneck

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: layers affected by the domain gap vary dynamically de-

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: pending on the model architecture and scene characteris-

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: tics. To address this dynamic behavior, BiLaLoRA employs

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: low-rank adaptation for parameter-efficient fine-tuning and

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: unifies the selection of adapter injection layers with weight

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: optimization into a bilevel optimization problem, enabling

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: more precise and efficient cross-domain adaptation. The

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: main contributions are summarized as follows:

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: Parameter-Efficient Fine-Tuning (PEFT) offers a solution

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: to the aforementioned challenges. The core principle of

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: PEFT is to freeze the pre-trained model while adapting only

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: a small number of additional parameters, thereby enabling

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: rapid adaptation to new tasks at a minimal computational

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: cost. Low-Rank Adaptation (LoRA) [2O] represents a sem-

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: inal PEFT technique that achieves performance compara-

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: ble to full fine-tuning by injecting trainable low-rank ma-

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: trices into selected weight layers. Originally developed

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: for natural language processing, LoRA has been success-

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: · To mitigate the heavy cost of full model fine-tuning,

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: we introduce BiLaLoRA,an effcient adaptation strat-

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: egy. Through bi-level optimization of both the LoRA po-

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: sitions and weights,it automatically pinpoints and fine-

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: tunes bottleneck layers without manual configuration.

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: 2.1. Real Image Dehazing

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: Real image dehazing aims to mitigate the negative effects

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: of natural haze on visual quality as well as restore the

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: colors and details. Although deep learning-based dehaz-

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: ing models demonstrate strong performance on synthetic

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: datasets,they exhibit significant performance degradation

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: in real-world scenes due to the synthetic-to-real domain

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: gap.To bridge this gap,researchers have developed var-

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: ious strategies to reduce the distribution discrepancy be-

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: tween domains.Domain adaptation methods enhance cross-

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: domain generalization by aligning feature distributions be-

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: tween source and target domains [37]. Physics-based prior-

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: constrained methods integrate the atmospheric scattering

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: model into the network design,guiding the model to learn

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: more physically interpretable representations [3] [9]. Unsu-

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: pervised approaches leverage Generative Adversarial Net-

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: works（GANs） to learn the dehazing mapping from un-

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: paired data,thereby alleviating the dependency on large-

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: scale labeled datasets [42] [4O]. Other solutions involve us-

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: ing test-time adaptation for dynamically adjusting feature

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: statistics [4] and leveraging pre-trained visual priors like

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: VQGAN to boost content generation [41] [16]. Neverthe-

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: less, these approaches are typically constrained by complex

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: training pipelines and substantial computational overhead,

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: while lacking the flexibility necessary to accommodate di-

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: verse real-world degradation patterns.

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: 3.1. Latent Cross-Modality Consistency

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: In real image dehazing,a fundamental challenge arises from

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: the absence of paired ground-truth clear images.This inher-

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: ent limitation renders supervised paradigms that rely on ref-

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: erence images and pixel-level loss functions inapplicable.

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: However, humans distinguish haze and clear images not re-

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: lying on pixel-wise correspondences, but through high-level

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: semantic understanding of the scene. This observation sug-

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: gests that if such semantic comprehension can be formu-

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: lated as computable guidance signals, it may be possible to

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: circumvent the dependency on reference images.

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: Fortunately, the advent of vision-language models like

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: CLIP has provided new pathways for addressing this chal-

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: lenge [27]. By constructing a unified latent embedding

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: space, CLIP can effectively quantify the semantic content

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: of images. Leveraging this capability, we propose a novel

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: strategy based on the principle of cross-modality consis-

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: tency, reconceptualizing the dehazing process as a semantic

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: mapping from haze to clear and accordingly formulating an

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: optimization objective that requires no paired supervision.

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: fully extended to computer vision tasks [32]. For instance,

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: Sun et al. [38] decoupled pixel-level reconstruction from

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: semantic enhancement through LoRA modules,achieving

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: high-quality controllable image super-resolution. Similarly,

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: Zhong et al. [47] integrate LoRA with lightweight convo-

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: lutions to incorporate local visual priors into the Segment

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: Anything Model (SAM), substantially improving its cross-

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: domain generalization in semantic segmentation. These

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: successes demonstrate that LoRA provides an effcient and

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: flexible paradigm for domain adaptation in vision tasks, par-

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: ticularly in resource constrained scenarios or situations re-

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: quiring rapid adaptation to multiple target domains.

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: Within the latent embedding space, the semantic trans-

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: formation produced by the dehazing model is characterized

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: by the displacement vector

layout_dets.label: ocr_text

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: codes the perceptual shift from haze to clear image.Con-

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: that represents the desired semantic trajectory in

layout_dets.label: ocr_text

layout_dets.label: ocr_text

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: able architecture parameters. However, simultaneously op-

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: timizing both architecture parameters and weight incre-
